mods.name: WaterFrames
mods.description:
Is just a mod to show media
in your game has a paint, tv. #DisplayIt #ProjectIt #ShowIt

releases.notes:
# BUG FIXES
- Fixed default's URL for whitelist aren't loaded correctly (you may need reset whitelist config)
- [1.19.2] Rebuilded and tested JAR 2 times to ensure everything is working FINE

# FEATURES
- Ensure playback state (paused or playing) at video display starting (good for copy paused frames)

# CHANGES
- [1.20.x] Since NeoForge is planning make Forge like Fabric (NeoFabric) i'll keep following forge parity, if for some reason Neo does breaking (fabric) changes then i'll drop support.
